bio: A terrific place that is understandably popular! The picturesque location on a hill with a wonderful garden and view of the lake is its calling card – needless to say, the terrace is a big hit in summer! Dining inside the Eder family's traditional inn is also an excellent option, whether in the more cosy dining area or in the airy, modern extension. The service is friendly and professional with a personal touch. As for the sophisticated dishes, choose à la carte or opt for one of three set menus – omnivore, vegetarian or fish and shellfish. Another stand-out feature is the extensive, top-notch wine list. Their lunch menu is also an appealing option....
